        Idea:
Add `--mode joke` to megaplan as a flag-sibling of `--mode doc`, scoped to film scene scripts only. Prose artifact written to --output, single file. Reuse the full phase graph (prep → plan → critique → revise → gate → execute → review → finalize) — scene scripts have enough craft surface (objective/obstacle/turn/button) for revise to do real integration work.

Core invention: critique flips from evaluative to generative. Add a JOKE_CRITIQUE_CHECKS registry paralleling CRITIQUE_CHECKS in audits/robustness.py — chaos-lens personas (absurdist, twist-ending, hyper-specific-detail, genre-swap, subtext-inversion, prop-as-character, bathos, scale-shift, narrator-reveal) that emit FLAG suggestions as committed generative proposals, not cautious hedges. Plug into the existing single_check_critique_prompt machinery at prompts/critique.py:354 — no new parallel infrastructure needed.

The load-bearing prompt is revise_joke. Unlike code-mode revise (which must address every flag), joke-mode revise must explicitly license REJECTING flags that fight the declared primary criterion or each other. Its job is selection and coherent integration, not exhaustive address. Get this wrong and the harness sands off every weird edge.

A primary criterion ("weirdest coherent," "most bathetic," "darkest that plays funny," etc.) is declared in prep and becomes the through-line — same structural role as doc mode's output_path contract at prompts/planning.py:93. Carried into plan's canvas, biases each critique lens, drives revise's selection, scores review's judgment.

Plan produces a scene canvas (premise, tone anchor, characters, objective, obstacle, turn, button) — not a task list. Execute writes the scene prose to --output, doc-mode style. Review judges against brief + criterion.

Out of scope for this run: tweets, names, outlines, one-liner jokes. Short-form pieces want a selection shape (no revise loop) that's a separate design — defer.

Key files to touch: schemas.py:385 (mode enum), cli.py:840 (--mode choices + help), prompts/__init__.py:113 (route prep/plan/critique/revise/execute/review to joke variants), audits/robustness.py:20 (new JOKE_CRITIQUE_CHECKS registry). New prompt builders: prep_joke.py, planning_joke.py (or inline branch), critique_joke.py, revise_joke.py, execute_joke.py, review_joke.py. Check prompts/finalize.py:32 and prompts/review.py:85 for mode branches where needed. Evaluation path in evaluation.py:123 likely needs a joke branch similar to the doc branch.

Build order: (1) schema/CLI plumbing so --mode joke is accepted; (2) JOKE_CRITIQUE_CHECKS lens registry; (3) revise_joke prompt FIRST among builders — it's load-bearing; (4) remaining prompt builders; (5) execute/review wiring and smoke test with a short brief.

Add `--mode joke` to megaplan as a flag-sibling of `--mode doc`, scoped to film scene scripts only. Prose artifact written to --output, single file. Core invention: critique flips from evaluative to generative. Add a JOKE_CRITIQUE_CHECKS registry paralleling CRITIQUE_CHECKS in audits/robustness.py — chaos-lens personas (absurdist, twist-ending, hyper-specific-detail, genre-swap, subtext-inversion, prop-as-character, bathos, scale-shift, narrator-reveal) that emit FLAG suggestions as committed generative proposals, not cautious hedges. Plug into the existing single_check_critique_prompt machinery at prompts/critique.py:354 — no new parallel infrastructure needed.

The load-bearing prompt is revise_joke. Unlike code-mode revise (which must address every flag), joke-mode revise must explicitly license REJECTING flags that fight the declared primary criterion or each other. Its job is selection and coherent integration, not exhaustive address. Get this wrong and the harness sands off every weird edge.

A primary criterion ("weirdest coherent," "most bathetic," "darkest that plays funny," etc.) is declared in prep and becomes the through-line — same structural role as doc mode's output_path contract at prompts/planning.py:93. Carried into plan's canvas, biases each critique lens, drives revise's selection, scores review's judgment.

Plan produces a scene canvas (premise, tone anchor, characters, objective, obstacle, turn, button) — not a task list. Execute writes the scene prose to --output, doc-mode style. Review judges against brief + criterion.

Out of scope for this run: tweets, names, outlines, one-liner jokes. Short-form pieces want a selection shape (no revise loop) that's a separate design — defer.

  "meta_commentary": "EXECUTION GUIDANCE FOR THE IMPLEMENTER:\n\n(1) SEQUENCING IS LOAD-BEARING. Land tasks strictly in T1\u2192T11 order. Two ordering constraints come straight from the brief and gate:\n    - After Phase 1 (T1\u2013T4), STOP and confirm the plumbing test (T4) is green before starting Phase 2.\n    - Within Phase 3, T7 (`_revise_joke_prompt`) must land BEFORE T8 (the other builders). The brief is explicit: revise is the load-bearing prompt \u2014 without its rejection-licensing semantics, every downstream Phase-3 prompt produces mush.\n\n(2) THE INVENTION YOU ARE BUILDING. Joke mode flips critique from evaluative \u2192 generative. The 9 lens personas in `JOKE_CRITIQUE_CHECKS` each emit ONE committed FLAG per critique pass \u2014 a concrete, named proposal (specific beat, prop, line, reveal), not a hedged \"consider X.\" The revise prompt then treats those flags as a *menu* it can reject. This is the entire point. If your guidance text or revise body softens this into \"consider these suggestions,\" the feature is broken even if all tests pass.\n\n(3) DOC-PARITY IS THE DEFAULT. Almost everywhere outside critique + revise, joke behaves like doc. Single output file via `--output`. Reuses `execution_doc.json` schema. `sections_written` carries scene-beat IDs. Don't fork what you don't need to fork \u2014 widen each existing `mode == \"doc\"` check to `mode in {\"doc\", \"joke\"}` and move on. Specific lines to widen are in T3.\n\n(4) WHAT NOT TO DO.\n    - Do NOT merge JOKE_CRITIQUE_CHECKS into CRITIQUE_CHECKS \u2014 they stay separate registries with mode-aware dispatch.\n    - Do NOT create planning_joke.py \u2014 branch in-file inside `_plan_prompt`. Planning boilerplate is shared.\n    - Do NOT fork parallel-critique infrastructure to fix the degraded sequential path. The canonical joke flow is parallel-hermes (one lens per subprocess); sequential lens-melt is an accepted fallback.\n    - Do NOT create joke variants of `gate` or `finalize` \u2014 defaults are generic enough.\n    - Do NOT chase the brief's mention of `schemas.py:385 (mode enum)` \u2014 that line is an `evidence_type` enum in `tiebreaker_researcher.json`, unrelated. Mode choices live ONLY in argparse at cli.py:840.\n    - Do NOT touch short-form ideas (tweets, names, one-liners). Out of scope per the brief.\n\n(5) PRIMARY CRITERION HAS THREE PATHS INTO STATE. Surface via `--primary-criterion` CLI flag (joke-only); harvested from `prep.json` after `handle_prep` runs (the canonical anchor is the line right after `_write_json_artifact(plan_dir, prep_filename, worker.payload)` at handlers/plan.py:71); raised as `invalid_state` at plan time if still empty. The plan-time enforcement is the safety net \u2014 keep it.\n\n(6) JUDGMENT CALLS THE EXECUTOR MAY ENCOUNTER:\n    - If `compute_task_batches` for a joke run never produces >1 batch in practice, you may skip `_execute_joke_batch_prompt` and add it later. The plan suggests mirroring execute_doc.py which has both \u2014 defensive but not strictly required if your smoke tests stay single-batch.\n    - The lens guidance text matters more than the guidance for code-mode checks because it directly shapes the model's generative output. Spend extra care drafting the guidance fields for the 9 lenses; vague guidance = vague proposals.\n    - When widening doc-only branches in T3, lean toward over-widening (treat joke as doc anywhere ambiguous) rather than under-widening \u2014 a missed branch surfaces as a runtime failure, while a wrongly-widened branch still gives joke functional behavior.\n\n(7) TWO INFO-PRIORITY CRITERIA REQUIRE HUMAN EVAL (verifiability-0 and verifiability-1 in the flag registry): \"9 lens personas produce visibly distinct proposals\" and \"revise_joke produces a scene canvas that rejects at least one flag with reason.\" These are NOT blocking \u2014 flag them in finalize and ship.\n\n(8) THE GATE RECOMMENDATION WAS ITERATE (light robustness, single revision pass). Plan-version 2 has zero unaddressed critique flags. The work is well-scoped; trust the plan.\n\n(9) THE FINAL TASK (T11) is the test gate. It includes (a) targeted regression on critique infra, (b) full pytest -x, (c) optional manual init+prep smoke, and (d) a throwaway reproduction script that exercises the load-bearing `_revise_joke_prompt` end-to-end (then deletes itself).         Idea:
Add `--mode joke` to megaplan as a flag-sibling of `--mode doc`, scoped to film scene scripts only. Prose artifact written to --output, single file. Reuse the full phase graph (prep → plan → critique → revise → gate → execute → review → finalize) — scene scripts have enough craft surface (objective/obstacle/turn/button) for revise to do real integration work.

Core invention: critique flips from evaluative to generative. Add a JOKE_CRITIQUE_CHECKS registry paralleling CRITIQUE_CHECKS in audits/robustness.py — chaos-lens personas (absurdist, twist-ending, hyper-specific-detail, genre-swap, subtext-inversion, prop-as-character, bathos, scale-shift, narrator-reveal) that emit FLAG suggestions as committed generative proposals, not cautious hedges. Plug into the existing single_check_critique_prompt machinery at prompts/critique.py:354 — no new parallel infrastructure needed.

The load-bearing prompt is revise_joke. Unlike code-mode revise (which must address every flag), joke-mode revise must explicitly license REJECTING flags that fight the declared primary criterion or each other. Its job is selection and coherent integration, not exhaustive address. Get this wrong and the harness sands off every weird edge.

A primary criterion ("weirdest coherent," "most bathetic," "darkest that plays funny," etc.) is declared in prep and becomes the through-line — same structural role as doc mode's output_path contract at prompts/planning.py:93. Carried into plan's canvas, biases each critique lens, drives revise's selection, scores review's judgment.

Plan produces a scene canvas (premise, tone anchor, characters, objective, obstacle, turn, button) — not a task list. Execute writes the scene prose to --output, doc-mode style. Review judges against brief + criterion.

Out of scope for this run: tweets, names, outlines, one-liner jokes. Short-form pieces want a selection shape (no revise loop) that's a separate design — defer.

Key files to touch: schemas.py:385 (mode enum), cli.py:840 (--mode choices + help), prompts/__init__.py:113 (route prep/plan/critique/revise/execute/review to joke variants), audits/robustness.py:20 (new JOKE_CRITIQUE_CHECKS registry). New prompt builders: prep_joke.py, planning_joke.py (or inline branch), critique_joke.py, revise_joke.py, execute_joke.py, review_joke.py. Check prompts/finalize.py:32 and prompts/review.py:85 for mode branches where needed. Evaluation path in evaluation.py:123 likely needs a joke branch similar to the doc branch.

Build order: (1) schema/CLI plumbing so --mode joke is accepted; (2) JOKE_CRITIQUE_CHECKS lens registry; (3) revise_joke prompt FIRST among builders — it's load-bearing; (4) remaining prompt builders; (5) execute/review wiring and smoke test with a short brief.

        Idea:
Add `--mode joke` to megaplan as a flag-sibling of `--mode doc`, scoped to film scene scripts only. Prose artifact written to --output, single file. Reuse the full phase graph (prep → plan → critique → revise → gate → execute → review → finalize) — scene scripts have enough craft surface (objective/obstacle/turn/button) for revise to do real integration work.

Core invention: critique flips from evaluative to generative. Add a JOKE_CRITIQUE_CHECKS registry paralleling CRITIQUE_CHECKS in audits/robustness.py — chaos-lens personas (absurdist, twist-ending, hyper-specific-detail, genre-swap, subtext-inversion, prop-as-character, bathos, scale-shift, narrator-reveal) that emit FLAG suggestions as committed generative proposals, not cautious hedges. Plug into the existing single_check_critique_prompt machinery at prompts/critique.py:354 — no new parallel infrastructure needed.

The load-bearing prompt is revise_joke. Unlike code-mode revise (which must address every flag), joke-mode revise must explicitly license REJECTING flags that fight the declared primary criterion or each other. Its job is selection and coherent integration, not exhaustive address. Get this wrong and the harness sands off every weird edge.

A primary criterion ("weirdest coherent," "most bathetic," "darkest that plays funny," etc.) is declared in prep and becomes the through-line — same structural role as doc mode's output_path contract at prompts/planning.py:93. Carried into plan's canvas, biases each critique lens, drives revise's selection, scores review's judgment.

Plan produces a scene canvas (premise, tone anchor, characters, objective, obstacle, turn, button) — not a task list. Execute writes the scene prose to --output, doc-mode style. Review judges against brief + criterion.

Out of scope for this run: tweets, names, outlines, one-liner jokes. Short-form pieces want a selection shape (no revise loop) that's a separate design — defer.

Add `--mode joke` to megaplan as a flag-sibling of `--mode doc`, scoped to film scene scripts only. Prose artifact written to --output, single file. Core invention: critique flips from evaluative to generative. Add a JOKE_CRITIQUE_CHECKS registry paralleling CRITIQUE_CHECKS in audits/robustness.py — chaos-lens personas (absurdist, twist-ending, hyper-specific-detail, genre-swap, subtext-inversion, prop-as-character, bathos, scale-shift, narrator-reveal) that emit FLAG suggestions as committed generative proposals, not cautious hedges. Plug into the existing single_check_critique_prompt machinery at prompts/critique.py:354 — no new parallel infrastructure needed.

The load-bearing prompt is revise_joke. Unlike code-mode revise (which must address every flag), joke-mode revise must explicitly license REJECTING flags that fight the declared primary criterion or each other. Its job is selection and coherent integration, not exhaustive address. Get this wrong and the harness sands off every weird edge.

A primary criterion ("weirdest coherent," "most bathetic," "darkest that plays funny," etc.) is declared in prep and becomes the through-line — same structural role as doc mode's output_path contract at prompts/planning.py:93. Carried into plan's canvas, biases each critique lens, drives revise's selection, scores review's judgment.

Plan produces a scene canvas (premise, tone anchor, characters, objective, obstacle, turn, button) — not a task list. Execute writes the scene prose to --output, doc-mode style. Review judges against brief + criterion.

Out of scope for this run: tweets, names, outlines, one-liner jokes. Short-form pieces want a selection shape (no revise loop) that's a separate design — defer.

The load-bearing prompt is revise_joke. Unlike code-mode revise (which must address every flag), joke-mode revise must explicitly license REJECTING flags that fight the declared primary criterion or each other. Its job is selection and coherent integration, not exhaustive address. Get this wrong and the harness sands off every weird edge.

A primary criterion ("weirdest coherent," "most bathetic," "darkest that plays funny," etc.) is declared in prep and becomes the through-line — same structural role as doc mode's output_path contract at prompts/planning.py:93. Carried into plan's canvas, biases each critique lens, drives revise's selection, scores review's judgment.

Plan produces a scene canvas (premise, tone anchor, characters, objective, obstacle, turn, button) — not a task list. Execute writes the scene prose to --output, doc-mode style. Review judges against brief + criterion.

Add `--mode joke` to megaplan as a flag-sibling of `--mode doc`, scoped to film scene scripts only. Prose artifact written to --output, single file. Core invention: critique flips from evaluative to generative. Add a JOKE_CRITIQUE_CHECKS registry paralleling CRITIQUE_CHECKS in audits/robustness.py — chaos-lens personas (absurdist, twist-ending, hyper-specific-detail, genre-swap, subtext-inversion, prop-as-character, bathos, scale-shift, narrator-reveal) that emit FLAG suggestions as committed generative proposals, not cautious hedges. Plug into the existing single_check_critique_prompt machinery at prompts/critique.py:354 — no new parallel infrastructure needed.

The load-bearing prompt is revise_joke. Unlike code-mode revise (which must address every flag), joke-mode revise must explicitly license REJECTING flags that fight the declared primary criterion or each other. Its job is selection and coherent integration, not exhaustive address. Get this wrong and the harness sands off every weird edge.

A primary criterion ("weirdest coherent," "most bathetic," "darkest that plays funny," etc.) is declared in prep and becomes the through-line — same structural role as doc mode's output_path contract at prompts/planning.py:93. Carried into plan's canvas, biases each critique lens, drives revise's selection, scores review's judgment.

Plan produces a scene canvas (premise, tone anchor, characters, objective, obstacle, turn, button) — not a task list. Execute writes the scene prose to --output, doc-mode style. Review judges against brief + criterion.

Out of scope for this run: tweets, names, outlines, one-liner jokes. Short-form pieces want a selection shape (no revise loop) that's a separate design — defer.

The brief is explicit: revise is the load-bearing prompt \u2014 without its rejection-licensing semantics, every downstream Phase-3 prompt produces mush.\n\n(2) THE INVENTION YOU ARE BUILDING. Joke mode flips critique from evaluative \u2192 generative. The 9 lens personas in `JOKE_CRITIQUE_CHECKS` each emit ONE committed FLAG per critique pass \u2014 a concrete, named proposal (specific beat, prop, line, reveal), not a hedged \"consider X.\" The revise prompt then treats those flags as a *menu* it can reject. This is the entire point. If your guidance text or revise body softens this into \"consider these suggestions,\" the feature is broken even if all tests pass.\n\n(3) DOC-PARITY IS THE DEFAULT. Almost everywhere outside critique + revise, joke behaves like doc. Single output file via `--output`. Reuses `execution_doc.json` schema. `sections_written` carries scene-beat IDs. Don't fork what you don't need to fork \u2014 widen each existing `mode == \"doc\"` check to `mode in {\"doc\", \"joke\"}` and move on. Specific lines to widen are in T3.\n\n(4) WHAT NOT TO DO.\n    - Do NOT merge JOKE_CRITIQUE_CHECKS into CRITIQUE_CHECKS \u2014 they stay separate registries with mode-aware dispatch.\n    - Do NOT create planning_joke.py \u2014 branch in-file inside `_plan_prompt`. The canonical joke flow is parallel-hermes (one lens per subprocess); sequential lens-melt is an accepted fallback.\n    - Do NOT create joke variants of `gate` or `finalize` \u2014 defaults are generic enough.\n    - Do NOT chase the brief's mention of `schemas.py:385 (mode enum)` \u2014 that line is an `evidence_type` enum in `tiebreaker_researcher.json`, unrelated. Mode choices live ONLY in argparse at cli.py:840.\n    - Do NOT touch short-form ideas (tweets, names, one-liners). Out of scope per the brief.\n\n(5) PRIMARY CRITERION HAS THREE PATHS INTO STATE. Surface via `--primary-criterion` CLI flag (joke-only); harvested from `prep.json` after `handle_prep` runs (the canonical anchor is the line right after `_write_json_artifact(plan_dir, prep_filename, worker.payload)` at handlers/plan.py:71); raised as `invalid_state` at plan time if still empty. The plan-time enforcement is the safety net \u2014 keep it.\n\n(6) JUDGMENT CALLS THE EXECUTOR MAY ENCOUNTER:\n    - If `compute_task_batches` for a joke run never produces >1 batch in practice, you may skip `_execute_joke_batch_prompt` and add it later. Add `--mode joke` to megaplan as a flag-sibling of `--mode doc`, scoped to film scene scripts only. Prose artifact written to --output, single file. Reuse the full phase graph (prep → plan → critique → revise → gate → execute → review → finalize) — scene scripts have enough craft surface (objective/obstacle/turn/button) for revise to do real integration work.

Core invention: critique flips from evaluative to generative. Add a JOKE_CRITIQUE_CHECKS registry paralleling CRITIQUE_CHECKS in audits/robustness.py — chaos-lens personas (absurdist, twist-ending, hyper-specific-detail, genre-swap, subtext-inversion, prop-as-character, bathos, scale-shift, narrator-reveal) that emit FLAG suggestions as committed generative proposals, not cautious hedges. Plug into the existing single_check_critique_prompt machinery at prompts/critique.py:354 — no new parallel infrastructure needed.

The load-bearing prompt is revise_joke. Unlike code-mode revise (which must address every flag), joke-mode revise must explicitly license REJECTING flags that fight the declared primary criterion or each other. Its job is selection and coherent integration, not exhaustive address. Get this wrong and the harness sands off every weird edge.

A primary criterion ("weirdest coherent," "most bathetic," "darkest that plays funny," etc.) is declared in prep and becomes the through-line — same structural role as doc mode's output_path contract at prompts/planning.py:93. Carried into plan's canvas, biases each critique lens, drives revise's selection, scores review's judgment.

Plan produces a scene canvas (premise, tone anchor, characters, objective, obstacle, turn, button) — not a task list. Execute writes the scene prose to --output, doc-mode style. Review judges against brief + criterion.

Out of scope for this run: tweets, names, outlines, one-liner jokes. Short-form pieces want a selection shape (no revise loop) that's a separate design — defer.

Key files to touch: schemas.py:385 (mode enum), cli.py:840 (--mode choices + help), prompts/__init__.py:113 (route prep/plan/critique/revise/execute/review to joke variants), audits/robustness.py:20 (new JOKE_CRITIQUE_CHECKS registry). New prompt builders: prep_joke.py, planning_joke.py (or inline branch), critique_joke.py, revise_joke.py, execute_joke.py, review_joke.py. Check prompts/finalize.py:32 and prompts/review.py:85 for mode branches where needed. Evaluation path in evaluation.py:123 likely needs a joke branch similar to the doc branch.

Build order: (1) schema/CLI plumbing so --mode joke is accepted; (2) JOKE_CRITIQUE_CHECKS lens registry; (3) revise_joke prompt FIRST among builders — it's load-bearing; (4) remaining prompt builders; (5) execute/review wiring and smoke test with a short brief.

(flagged 1 times across 1 plans)
- [DEBT] are-the-proposed-changes-technically-correct: are the proposed changes technically correct?: checked the new diff-helper proposal against the repo's existing execution-evidence semantics. `validate_execution_evidence()` in `megaplan/evaluation.py:109-175` uses `git status --short`, so untracked files count as real changed files today, but step 3 proposes `collect_git_diff_patch(project_dir)` via `git diff head`; by git behavior that will not include untracked files, so heavy review could miss exactly the newly created files that execute and review already treat as part of the patch. Core invention: critique flips from evaluative to generative. Add a JOKE_CRITIQUE_CHECKS registry paralleling CRITIQUE_CHECKS in audits/robustness.py — chaos-lens personas (absurdist, twist-ending, hyper-specific-detail, genre-swap, subtext-inversion, prop-as-character, bathos, scale-shift, narrator-reveal) that emit FLAG suggestions as committed generative proposals, not cautious hedges. Plug into the existing single_check_critique_prompt machinery at prompts/critique.py:354 — no new parallel infrastructure needed.

The load-bearing prompt is revise_joke. Unlike code-mode revise (which must address every flag), joke-mode revise must explicitly license REJECTING flags that fight the declared primary criterion or each other. Its job is selection and coherent integration, not exhaustive address. Get this wrong and the harness sands off every weird edge.

A primary criterion ("weirdest coherent," "most bathetic," "darkest that plays funny," etc.) is declared in prep and becomes the through-line — same structural role as doc mode's output_path contract at prompts/planning.py:93. Carried into plan's canvas, biases each critique lens, drives revise's selection, scores review's judgment.

Plan produces a scene canvas (premise, tone anchor, characters, objective, obstacle, turn, button) — not a task list. Execute writes the scene prose to --output, doc-mode style. Review judges against brief + criterion.

Out of scope for this run: tweets, names, outlines, one-liner jokes. Short-form pieces want a selection shape (no revise loop) that's a separate design — defer.

This is the entire point. If your guidance text or revise body softens this into \"consider these suggestions,\" the feature is broken even if all tests pass.\n\n(3) DOC-PARITY IS THE DEFAULT. The load-bearing prompt is revise_joke. Unlike code-mode revise (which must address every flag), joke-mode revise must explicitly license REJECTING flags that fight the declared primary criterion or each other. Its job is selection and coherent integration, not exhaustive address. Get this wrong and the harness sands off every weird edge.

Carried into plan's canvas, biases each critique lens, drives revise's selection, scores review's judgment.

Plan produces a scene canvas (premise, tone anchor, characters, objective, obstacle, turn, button) — not a task list. Execute writes the scene prose to --output, doc-mode style. Review judges against brief + criterion.
